artwork_method: Image generation adapted the user-approved original sheet into transparent registered cutout parts and two original background plates. Animation and compositing use Remotion.
atlas_layout: 1536x1024, four 384-pixel columns and two 512-pixel rows. Mira row: body, happy head, worried head, cup arm. Sol row: body, attentive head, closed-eye head, gesture arm.
blink_atlas: Mira eye variants and a corrected cup-arm shoulder; body and hair placement retained. Eye-area clipping in Remotion avoids swapping entire head silhouettes during blinks.
source_pixels_note: Generated cutouts preserve the approved character design but are adapted drawings, not pixel-identical crops of the original sheet. The approved master remains unchanged.
